svg.aria-label: 04 Learn and rehearse a harmony part
svg.title: 04 Learn and rehearse a harmony part - Second Voice UI mockup
svg.desc: Illustrative desktop interface for a songwriter's harmony sketchpad. This is a design mockup, not a transcription service.
svg.text: Listen to your line. Sing it with the lead. Let the guide fade away.
A little quieter each time the phrase loops.
Hold your part against the lead.
The colored notes are yours. The original melody stays in the background.
This phrase repeats. Stop whenever you need.
Ready to record the real thing?
Take a piano guide or MIDI part into your recording session.
Desktop UI concept. All notes and takes shown are illustrative.
